title: PostgreSQL: Internals & Practice
prereqs: Docker (challenges spin up a local Postgres)
description: PostgreSQL from the inside out and the hands-on down: MVCC & tuple visibility, the WAL, shared buffers & the background writer, VACUUM/autovacuum & bloat, the query planner & EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index types (B-tree/GIN/GiST/BRIN/Hash), TOAST, transactions & isolation levels, partitioning, replication & logical decoding, connection pooling, and real performance tuning — every topic paired with a runnable exercise against a local Postgres.
